title: Brought code-health analysis into a product pipeline
summary: I helped a systems business add code-health analysis to its pipeline and reviewed progress with its leaders.
what_would_have_happened: Code health would stay invisible until defects appeared.
the_call: Put the analysis in the pipeline, not in a report.
what_i_did: Supported the integration and the review.
what_changed: The business reviewed it in its progress dialogue.
